hooks.command: if workflow guard --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'possible values:.*bash'; then workflow guard bash; fi
if workflow guard --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'possible values:.*edit'; then workflow guard edit; fi

if workflow worktree --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'possible values: create, remove'; then workflow worktree create; else n=$(sed -n 's/.*"name" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); d="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.claude/worktrees/$n"; git worktree add -q -b "worktree-$n" "$d" HEAD >&2 && cd "$d" && pwd -P; fi

if workflow worktree --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'possible values: create, remove'; then workflow worktree remove; else git worktree remove "$(sed -n 's/.*"worktree_path" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"; fi
